private theorem actual_gaussian_gram_means {d q : ℕ} (hq : 2 * q + 1 < d) :
  let θ : Fin d → ℝ := fun i => ((i.val : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Real.pi / (d : ℝ)
  let t : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin (q + 1)) ℝ := fun i k =>
    if k.val = 0 then 1 else Real.sqrt 2 * Real.cos ((k.val : ℝ) * θ i)
  let D : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ :=
    Matrix.diagonal (fun i => Real.cos (((2 * q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * θ i))
  let μ : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d × Fin (q + 1))) :=
    multivariateGaussian (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d × Fin (q + 1)))
      (1 : Matrix (Fin d × Fin (q + 1)) (Fin d × Fin (q + 1)) ℝ)
  let B : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d × Fin (q + 1)) →
      Matrix (Fin d) (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) ℝ := fun x i a =>
    (Real.sqrt (d : ℝ))⁻¹ * WithLp.ofLp x (i, a.1) * t i a.2
  ∀ a b : Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1),
    Integrable (fun x => ((B x).transpose * B x) a b) μ ∧
    Integrable (fun x => ((B x).transpose * D * B x) a b) μ ∧
    (∫ x, ((B x).transpose * B x) a b ∂μ) = (if a = b then 1 else 0) ∧
    (∫ x, ((B x).transpose * D * B x) a b ∂μ) = 0

definitions.name: ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian
definitions.meaning: The actual canonical mean-plus-covariance-square-root pushforward of standardGaussian. The covariance in this consumer is literally I on Fin d x Fin(q+1); positivity/probability and actual coordinate-product moments must be derived internally, excluding any non-PSD fallback. This is not a symbolic independent-variable certificate.

definitions.name: theta/t/D
definitions.meaning: All are literal let bodies in both sealed types. Fin indices start at0. r=q+1, theta_i=(i+1/2)pi/d. t_i0=1 and t_ik=sqrt2*cos(k theta_i) for k>0; D=diag(cos((2q+1)theta_i)). hq implies d>=2 and excludes denominator0. Matrix transpose is real transpose; product and scalar multiplication are ordinary matrix operations, with1 the identity.

definitions.name: B and mu
definitions.meaning: mu is actual centered Gaussian of identity covariance on EuclideanSpace indexed Fin d x Fin(q+1). B(x)_{i,(a,b)}=(sqrt d)^(-1)*x_(i,a)*t_(i,b). Product indices explicitly realize r squared columns and d rows. No supplied independent-row law, covariance, expectation, integrability or moment is bundled.

definitions.name: entrywise integrability and means
definitions.meaning: For every a,b in Fin r x Fin r, both actual Gram entries are Bochner integrable over the actual mu; unweighted mean is Kronecker identity, weighted mean is0. Entrywise expectation is the literal finite-dimensional matrix-expectation meaning; no conditional or adaptive random law is asserted.

literal_conventions.ranges: All naturals q including0; exact source2q+1<d impliesd>=2 and2(q+1)<=d. There is no kappa parameter because the cosine-frame component does not depend on kappa. Full source q range is retained.
literal_conventions.matrix_identities: t^T t=d I_(q+1); t^T D_(2q+1)t=0; each row squared Euclidean norm=sum squares<=2(q+1). Real transpose not conjugate transpose; realscalar d only.
literal_conventions.Gaussian_consumer: True joint standardGaussian in d*(q+1) coordinates, not unspecified random variables plus assumed covariance. Equality to the source independent g_a/row-law interpretation must be justified from actual law internally if used; row independence is not silently inserted as a premise.
literal_conventions.expectation: Entrywise Bochner integrability AND actual integral values; a totalized integral equality without integrability is insufficient.
literal_conventions.scope_boundary: Deterministic frame and actual Gaussian second-moment centering do not supply range(B)=Krylov, nonasymptotic op-norm concentration/absoluteC, positivity of a random Gram matrix, a Haar/adaptive/oracle/precision/TV/cap/cost adapter, either main lower bound or website delivery.
